SINGLAND-MARINA-20260901.claim: Owner announces Marina Square mall closure 2027-03-31, project expected 2031, hotels remain open and SingLand itself manages transition/footfall; no operator transfer right is offered.

CNA-NAMED-TENANTS-20260902.claim: Directly interviewed named affected tenants; Joraine Tan of Prestique reports malls have approached her; Stoneage Collection owner May Teo cites cost/lease uncertainty; Coco Veggie restaurateur reports prior moves and approaches. Media-interview evidence of their statements, not independent contract audit.

ST-MARINA-TENANTS-20260902.claim: Named Lava Floor venue initially lacked replacement-site plan at announcement. This is a dated observation, not proof of present unfilled demand or ownership of bookings.

PRESTIQUE-OFFICIAL-CURRENT.claim: Named studio's own site advertises an existing operational Marina Square location, public class offerings, operating hours and business contact; no authorized third-party relocation or member-portability API/public mandate established.

LAVAFLOOR-OFFICIAL-BOOK.claim: Venue operates its own direct booking surface at Marina Square. A public booking webpage does not confer external booking/customer-data control.

POPUPANGELS-OFFICIAL-CURRENT.claim: Exact incumbent offers searchable short-term retail spaces and expert-supported landlord matching and set-up; available catalog is not verified as accessible to every displaced operator.

POPUPANGELS-LANDLORD-CURRENT.claim: Landlords remain in control of accepting brands and projects while incumbent markets available space; there is no independent guaranteed sublease/booking right for an unaffiliated router.

GETSPACES-OFFICIAL-CURRENT.claim: Existing flexible-space marketplace markets short and longer rentals; marketplace offer alone does not prove any named Marina Square tenant booked there.

VOLM-REINSTATEMENT-20260827.claim: 2026 specialist offering explicitly covers retail reinstatement scoping, landlord/building coordination, final inspection and handover; vendor offer, not evidence every tenant's issue resolved.

MTI-RETAIL-LEASE-20260407.claim: Singapore MTI confirms qualified commercial retail leasing disputes can use existing LARPA Code and Singapore Mediation Centre mediation/adjudication framework; individual Marina Square lease eligibility/compensation facts not disclosed.

BT-EXITS-20260806.claim: Before September announcement, named PSB Academy and DP Architects had already organized relocation, supporting existing direct enterprise/landlord partial flows, not an independent routing mandate.

examined_formations.title: Named Prestique Studio March 2027 displacement -> operating-site and fitness-class continuity
examined_formations.observed_partial_flow: Named Joraine Tan reports multiple malls have approached Prestique; she reports no specific mall-provided relocation offer at first announcement. Existing specialist short-term mall-space matching is already sold; class and specific alternative site terms not publicly disclosed.
examined_formations.counterparty_surface: Several malls are reported to have directly offered space to the business. Landlords and current retail-space brokers control their unit offers and approvals; a third-party independent bookable venue inventory for appropriate trampoline fit-out is not demonstrated.
latent_outcome_alternatives: Maintain viable class location and member convenience
Negotiate lease compensation and minimize fit-out transition cost
Choose to change or close business if viable space costs cannot be cleared
examined_formations.causal_frontier: The publicly demonstrated hard constraint is lease/fit-out economics and tenant-landlord decisions; no public data identifies a distinct unowned repeated class-continuity routing edge.
examined_formations.discriminating_falsifier: Would need first-party repeated site-rejection/continuity failure records despite direct landlord offers, independently accessible appropriately fitted space inventory, and a legally callable tenant-authorized matching/booking and recurring operator-revenue right.
material_contradictions: Named tenant relocation is real but unsolicited direct mall offers are actual partial flow, so no absence of matching route is proven
Incumbent broker availability is not proof of all premises or special trampoline floor/loading fitness suitability
Specific booking, suitability certification, member-data authorization, success fee and independent route right are not in public evidence

examined_formations.title: Stoneage Collection / Coco Veggie Nyonya named long-lived retailers -> post-move customer and retail continuity
examined_formations.observed_partial_flow: Stoneage owner reports customers proactively messaging/advising a move while she cites age, effort and costly fit-out. Coco Veggie operator reports a prior food-court-to-restaurant relocation and that other malls have approached him already. PSB/DP independently show some named tenants can directly move, not proof all retailer economics are solved.
examined_formations.counterparty_surface: Retailers have known customer communities and potential alternative spaces through direct landlord contact and specialist space agents; customer lists, restaurant fit-out suitability, exact cashflow and permission to move customers through third-party tools are not available.
latent_outcome_alternatives: Preserve customer footfall via a suitable permanent destination
Operate online/popup while reducing fit-out downside
Conclude planned business operation rather than relocate when economics fail
examined_formations.causal_frontier: Tenants' fit-out costs, lease timing and business preference/physical demand differ. Customer affection or inbound landlord invitations cannot establish a generic third-party right to migrate customers or monetize the relocation.
examined_formations.discriminating_falsifier: Need opt-in merchant and customer-transfer permission, independently evidenced failed continuity after available incumbents, standardized destination constraints, and a publicly callable paid handoff without repeated manual merchant selling.
material_contradictions: Consumer concern in news does not prove data portability consent, real churn or willingness to pay an outside routing operator
Restaurant operator has already executed a prior direct relocation and reports mall approaches
Preexisting pop-up and mall letting offerings cannot be renamed as an unowned opportunity

examined_formations.title: Named tenants with leases beyond mall closure -> early-exit reinstatement/compensation acceptance
examined_formations.observed_partial_flow: Owners describe unresolved questions about early exit; SingLand says it will work directly with tenants on timeline and reinstatement. A named 2026 reinstatement provider markets end-to-end coordinated handover; regulator describes a separate existing dispute-resolution path for qualifying retail agreements. Neither fact establishes the outcome for specific tenants.
examined_formations.counterparty_surface: SingLand owns landlord-side approvals, individual tenants/contractors own site obligations, existing contractors handle handover; legal/dispute authority remains with parties and established forums, not an independent unmandated router.
latent_outcome_alternatives: Negotiate early lease termination/compensation with landlord
Commission specialist fit-out removal and successful final landlord acceptance
Escalate lease disputes through the appropriate formal route if qualification and evidence support it
examined_formations.causal_frontier: The decisive obligations are tenant-specific contracts, actual reinstatement scope and landlord decisions; available public evidence does not expose a repeatable open acceptance/settlement API or independent permission to act.
examined_formations.discriminating_falsifier: Need published or expressly granted case-class authorization to control the landlord acceptance rail, standardized accessible lease inputs, actual repeated cross-tenant failed handovers despite existing contractors, and a legitimate operator payment entitlement.
material_contradictions: Media interviews establish uncertainty, not that a legal duty to compensate or actual dispute outcome exists
Exact specialist 2026 contractor offers full landlord-coordinated handover, so generic contractor orchestration is not new control
Existing code/mediation availability is qualified and case-specific and gives no unaffiliated router execution authority

rights_preflight_boundary.source_interpretation: A named closure and active tenant behavior are verified. Independent legal permissions for a third-party to book a specific fit-for-purpose site, port a customer relationship, or accept the landlord's reinstatement are NOT evidenced and must not be inferred from public contact details or incumbent offers.
